versions.summary: Survivors: AI players who gather, build, lock, raid and fight on every server. Base cores, locks, explosives, upkeep and decay. Characters and building pieces remade in Blender with distance copies, and touch controls rebuilt.
features: Survivors on every server: AI players in teams of 1 to 4 who gather, craft tools and guns, build bases with walls, doors and high walls, lock them, upgrade to stone and metal, raid other bases with explosives, loot boxes and bodies, and defend their own

Half of the survivors arrive with a finished base and gear, the other half start from nothing. A server of 300 holds 250 survivors, a server of 100 holds 80; every real player who joins takes one survivor's seat

They fight like players: they aim with a reaction time and miss more when you move, strafe, take cover, reload, flee and bandage when hurt, and call their team. Unarmed newcomers are mostly left alone
The online counter shows real players only; the number of survivors on the server is shown beside it
Base core: stops anyone not authorised from building within 30 m, holds the upkeep materials and shows how long they last. A base that is not paid for decays
Key locks and code locks for doors, gates, boxes and the base core. Codes are checked on the server and never sent to other players
Raiding: powder bomb and breaching charge with a fuse; every material has its own resistance (tools barely scratch stone, metal needs charges). What stood on a destroyed piece comes down with it
New pieces: high wooden wall, high stone wall, wooden gate, watchtower, base core, key lock, code lock, gunpowder, powder bomb, breaching charge
PvE servers: survivors' bases can be raided, players' bases cannot. PvP and hardcore: everything can
improvements: Every building piece (foundation, floor, wall, doorway, window, roof, stairs, pillar) in all four tiers was remade in Blender: lashed poles, timber, cut stone, sheet metal
Doors, boxes, locks, walls, the gate, the watchtower, explosives and rocks are Blender models too
The name of a player or survivor shows when you look at him
All damage to bases, doors and boxes is decided by the server
fixes: Phones: every button answers on the first touch, also while another finger holds the stick. One manager now follows each finger by itself
Phones: tapping a hotbar slot switches the item at once (the look area used to cover the bar)
Phones: a tap shorter than one frame is no longer lost; dragging on the fire button turns the view
A deployable placed on a floor is removed when that floor is destroyed
performance: Characters have three lighter copies made in Blender (about 16,500, 3,600 and 800 triangles) and a 300-triangle far model drawn instanced: a crowd costs a fraction of what it did
Buildings and placed items switch to light copies at a distance; placed items are drawn instanced; buildings out of view are not drawn or kept in memory
Survivors far from every player are simulated at a lower rate and sent to each player by distance (10 times a second near, once a second far)
The server measures its own tick: if it runs late it lowers the number of survivors by itself until it is smooth again
knownIssues: Trees are still generated by code, not modelled in Blender
In singleplayer bases do not decay and there are no survivors

ar.summary: الناجين: لاعبين ذكاء اصطناعي يجمعون ويبنون ويقفلون ويسوون رايد ويقاتلون في كل السيرفرات. قلب القاعدة، أقفال، متفجرات، صيانة وتحلل. الشخصيات وقطع البناء انعادت في بلندر مع نسخ خفيفة للبعيد، وأزرار الجوال انبنت من جديد.
features: ناجين في كل السيرفرات: فرق من 1 إلى 4 يجمعون موارد، يصنعون أدوات وأسلحة، يبنون قواعد بجدران وأبواب وأسوار، يقفلونها، يطورونها لحجر وحديد، يسوون رايد بالمتفجرات، يتلوّتون الصناديق والجثث، ويحمون قواعدهم
نصهم يدخل وعنده قاعدة جاهزة وعتاد، والنص الثاني يبدأ من الصفر. سيرفر سعته 300 فيه 250 ناجي، وسعته 100 فيه 80، وكل لاعب حقيقي يدخل ياخذ مكان ناجي
يقاتلون زي اللاعبين: يصوبون بزمن ردة فعل ويخطون أكثر إذا تحركت، يتحركون يمين ويسار، يتحصنون، يلقمون، يهربون ويتعالجون إذا دمهم قليل، وينادون فريقهم. اللي ما معه سلاح غالباً يخلونه
عداد المتصلين يعرض اللاعبين الحقيقيين بس، وجنبه عدد الناجين في السيرفر
قلب القاعدة: يمنع غير المصرّحين يبنون في دائرة 30 متر، تحط فيه مواد الصيانة ويقول لك تكفي كم. القاعدة اللي ما تندفع صيانتها تتحلل
قفل مفتاح وقفل رقمي للأبواب والبوابات والصناديق وقلب القاعدة. الرقم السري ينفحص في السيرفر وما ينرسل لأحد
الرايد: قنبلة بارود وعبوة اختراق بفتيل، وكل مادة لها مقاومتها (الأدوات ما تأثر في الحجر، والحديد يبي عبوات). واللي فوق القطعة المدمرة يطيح معها
قطع جديدة: سور خشب عالي، سور حجر عالي، بوابة خشب، برج مراقبة، قلب القاعدة، قفل مفتاح، قفل رقمي، بارود، قنبلة بارود، عبوة اختراق
سيرفرات PvE: قواعد الناجين تنضرب، وقواعد اللاعبين لا. سيرفرات PvP والهاردكور: الكل ينضرب
improvements: كل قطع البناء (أساس، أرضية، جدار، فتحة باب، نافذة، سقف، درج، عمود) بالمستويات الأربعة انعادت في بلندر: أعواد مربوطة، خشب، حجر مقطوع، صفايح حديد
الأبواب والصناديق والأقفال والأسوار والبوابة والبرج والمتفجرات والصخور كلها موديلات بلندر
اسم اللاعب أو الناجي يطلع لما تصوّب عليه
أي ضرر على القواعد والأبواب والصناديق يقرره السيرفر
fixes: الجوال: كل زر يشتغل من أول لمسة حتى لو إصبع ثاني على الجويستك. صار فيه نظام واحد يتابع كل إصبع لحاله
الجوال: الضغط على خانة في الشريط يغيّر الغرض على طول (منطقة التلفت كانت تغطي الشريط)
الجوال: الضغطة السريعة ما تضيع، وسحب الإصبع على زر الضرب يلف الكاميرا
الغرض اللي فوق أرضية ينشال إذا تدمرت الأرضية
performance: الشخصيات لها ثلاث نسخ أخف مسوّاة في بلندر (حوالي 16,500 و3,600 و800 مثلث) وموديل للبعيد 300 مثلث ينرسم بالـ instancing: الزحمة صارت تكلف جزء بسيط من قبل
المباني والأغراض الموضوعة تتحول لنسخ خفيفة من بعيد، والأغراض تنرسم بالـ instancing، والمباني اللي برا النظر ما تنرسم ولا تنحفظ في الذاكرة
الناجين البعيدين عن كل اللاعبين يتحدثون بمعدل أقل، وينرسلون لكل لاعب حسب المسافة (10 مرات بالثانية للقريب، ومرة للبعيد)
السيرفر يقيس الـ tick حقه: إذا تأخر ينزّل عدد الناجين لحاله لين يرجع سلس
knownIssues: الشجر للحين يتولد بالكود، مو موديل بلندر
في اللعب الفردي القواعد ما تتحلل وما فيه ناجين

versions.summary: Smoother play in the new game window.
fixes: The native game window now runs with the same performance settings as before: no background throttling, the high-performance graphics card, sound without a click
No more short freeze when another player walks into view: the detailed player models are prepared in the background

versions.summary: The launcher and the game now open in their own native windows, like an installed game, instead of a browser window.
features: Native windows: the launcher and the game each open in a real Windows window with the ARVEX icon and title and their own taskbar entry, with no browser around them
Solo saves and game settings are carried over automatically from the old window
Opening the launcher a second time brings up its window instead of starting a second launcher
The launcher closes itself when every window is closed (it waits for running downloads first)
Falls back to the previous window automatically on PCs without the WebView2 runtime

versions.summary: ARVEX v10.0 rebuilds everything around the game: a real launcher and update system, a staff admin panel with a secured backend, signed releases with rollback, and a quality pass on rendering, the first-person hands and the settings.
features: Real surfaces: the ground, sand, rock, tree bark, wood, metal, cloth and skin now use photographed PBR textures with normal maps and physically based lighting (1K, 2K or 4K, set in Graphics → Surface textures)
Realistic first-person hand and arm: an anatomical model made in Blender (fingers, knuckles, nails, wrist) that really wraps the tool it holds

Real foliage: oak, birch and pine now carry leaf clusters and needle branches cut out with transparency, and the ground grows tufts of grass instead of flat blades. Leaves let sunlight through and cast leaf-shaped shadows
Fire you can read as fire: flickering tongues of flame, rising embers and smoke on campfires, furnaces and the torch
New launcher: shows installed and latest version with build ids, release date, update size, free disk space, server status, news and patch notes
New update engine: compressed, parallel downloads, resume after a dropped connection, SHA-256 check of every file, install with automatic rollback, repair of only the damaged files
Updates are signed (Ed25519). The launcher refuses unsigned, tampered or replayed update manifests
Launcher error codes (ARVEX-L/N/U/F/A/S…) with a plain explanation and a next step, plus a log file for support
Support page in the launcher: send a ticket and read the staff reply
Staff admin panel at /admin: dashboard, players, moderation, reports, tickets, releases, builds, patches, announcements, changelog, servers, logs, settings and security
Five staff roles (Owner, Admin, Developer, Moderator, Support) with server-side permissions, optional two-factor sign-in and a tamper-evident audit log
Release pipeline: draft → testing → QA → approved → published, with one-click rollback, mandatory updates, minimum supported version and maintenance mode
In-game /report <player> <reason> with evidence captured by the server
Graphics presets LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, EXTRA and MAX that change shadows, anti-aliasing, draw distance, vegetation, effects and model detail
Render resolution up to 8K (1080p, 2K, 4K, 6K, 8K) with a keep/revert countdown, FPS limit, fullscreen toggle, FXAA, shadow quality and shadow distance
Auto-detect picks a preset from your real GPU, CPU and memory; Reset to default; separate interface volume; aim-down-sights sensitivity
Item codes: enter a code in the pause menu to receive every weapon, tool and outfit with ammunition. Codes are checked by the game server and give items only
Shop: finishes for weapons and tools (Desert, Arctic, Carbon, Crimson, Gold) bought with coins you earn by playing. Nothing is sold for real money
improvements: The corrected third-person character (eyes, hair, clothing colours) is now in the build
The world around the spawn point is built before you get control (terrain and objects), so you never start in an empty map
Trees, rocks and props now receive shadows; MAX uses a 4096 shadow map with a 110 m reach
Loading screen shows the real loading phases, version and build
Bans, mutes, kicks and warnings are enforced by the game servers, not by the client
Servers accept a managed range of client versions instead of one exact version
Performance overlay shows average FPS, 1% low, frame time, render resolution, draw calls and triangles
fixes: Fixed the map sometimes not appearing: terrain, trees and objects could be rejected by the graphics driver, leaving only sky and water
Fixed stale game files after an update on the web version: files are revalidated on every load
Fixed launcher self-update installing a file without checking it: the download must now match a published SHA-256
Fixed leaving the map or falling under it: the player is put back on the ground
Fixed settings being lost when the saved file was damaged: invalid values fall back to defaults, old files are migrated
Codes entered online now deliver their items (the game ignored the server's answer)
Phones: tapping a hotbar slot switches item
Menu buttons near the bottom of the screen could be covered by the hotbar and not respond
The rock is held in an open grip instead of floating in front of the fist
performance: Unchanged files cost a 304 response instead of a download
Server validates hit rate, range and damage per weapon
On the web and on phones, textures are only downloaded at the size you selected (8 MB for 1K, 33 MB for 2K, 146 MB more for 4K); the PC launcher installs all of them (220 MB)
knownIssues: The hand uses one grip pose for every tool, and has no finger animation yet
Player inventories are still held by the client in multiplayer
The admin panel is in English only
Launcher: no minimise-to-tray and no light theme
On the free hosting plan, uploaded releases, staff accounts and bans are lost on every redeploy unless a persistent disk is attached

Frame rate and video-memory use with textures have not been measured on real graphics cards. 4K textures need about 1.1 GB of video memory; if the game is slow or the picture breaks, lower Surface textures or pick a lower preset
Finishes are stored on your device and other players do not see them yet

notes: Realistic human built in Blender from a real anatomical body: face, eyes, lips, hair, hands and fingers
Clothes: buttoned shirt, belt with buckle, pants and boots with soles
Fingers close around the held item; realistic first-person arm and hand
Every player gets a different skin, hair, eye and shirt colour
Exhausted animation when stamina runs out
Realistic human: Blender Human Base Meshes body (CC0) rigged, posed and dressed in Blender (face, eyes, hands, shirt, belt, boots, hair)
Exhausted animation when stamina is low
High-poly world: denser trees, rocks and grass, real-time shadows
New water shader: waves, foam, reflections and depth colour
Realistic animated players: walk/run, arms, knees, swing, held items
Detailed first-person hands, softer destruction sounds and debris
New weapons: sword, revolver, semi rifle, pump shotgun + ammo
Simpler mobile controls, smaller crosshair, light aim assist
In-game guide (H) and step-by-step objectives
Admin panel for the owner: teleport, give, weather, time
First release of ARVEX SURVIVAL
Open-world island with biomes, rivers, lakes and ruins
Gathering, crafting, workbenches, building with tiers
Animals with AI, day/night, weather
Multiplayer servers with playtime and automatic restarts
Official ARVEX launcher with incremental updates, verify and repair
